title: Push notifications silently dropped
description: Android push notifications never arrive; no error is logged anywhere. Seen on build 4821.

title: Sidebar mixes capitalization styles
description: Menu items mix title case and sentence case in the navigation sidebar. Seen on build 4821.

title: Uneven card padding on home page
description: Cards on the home page have extra padding on the right edge. Reported by a customer on the support portal.

title: Footer copyright year is outdated
description: The footer still shows last year in the copyright line. Seen on both web and mobile.

title: Duplicate charges on payment retry
description: Retrying a timed-out payment creates a second charge and corrupts the ledger state. Seen on both web and mobile.
